name: PicoFox (vendor firmware, files on its drive)
description: For the AI6YM PicoFox. Nothing is deployed to the board's firmware: the page writes settings.txt, an audio.wav rendered from the payload, its own Morse-ID audio (.callsign.wav) and the marker file the firmware checks. One frequency, a fixed duty cycle; the firmware adds its own carrier-offset and power stepping.
